mostWorthwhile.text: Building the muscle proteins was most worthwhile: the sliding fibres made the connection between the instructions and the cells' pulling job clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: The support-protein path felt repetitive after the muscle path, although its final result showed a useful difference.

surprise.text: I was interested that cells with the same DNA could use different instructions and place their proteins inside or outside the cell for different jobs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the messenger pairings were named and offered as compatible; I wasn't figuring out how the messengers worked in detail.

continue.text: I'd probably continue to see how these different cells become larger tissues, especially how muscle cells work together. The two paths were clear, though a little repetitive.
